form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Received; read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs

form.official-title: To amend the Export Control Reform Act of 2018 relating to licensing transparency.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Maintaining American Superiority by Improving Export Control Transparency Act.
Section 1756 of the Export Control Reform Act of 2018 (50 U.S.C. 4815) is amended by adding at the end the following:

paragraph.text: Not later than 90 days after the date of the enactment of this subsection, and not less frequently than every 90 days thereafter, the Secretary, shall submit to the appropriate congressional committees a report on license applications, enforcement actions, and other requests for authorization for the export, reexport, release, and in-country transfer of items controlled under this part to covered entities.
The report required by paragraph (1) shall include, with respect to the 90 days preceding the previous 90-day period, the following:

subparagraph.text: For each license application or other request for authorization, the name of the entity submitting the application (both parent company as well as the subsidiary directly involved), a brief description of the item (including the Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) and level of control, if applicable), the name of the end-user, the end-user’s location, a value estimate, decision with respect to the license application or authorization, and the date of submission.
The date, location, and result of site inspections, monitoring, and enforcement actions to ensure compliance with United States export controls.
Aggregate statistics on all license applications and other requests for authorization as described in subparagraph (A).

For each license denial in which items in category EAR99 constitute at least 50 percent of the financial value of the license application, a list detailing what specific items are being denied a license.

paragraph.text: The information required to be provided in the reports required by this subsection (other than the information required by paragraph (2)(C)) shall be exempt from public disclosure pursuant to section 1761(h)(1).

clause.text: the Committee on Foreign Affairs of the House of Representatives; and
the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs of the Senate; and

subparagraph.text: the term ‘covered entity’ means any entity included on—

clause.text: the list maintained and set forth in Supplement No. 4 to part 744 of the Export Administration Regulations; or
the list maintained and set forth in Supplement No. 7 to part 744 of the Export Administration Regulations.

attestation-group.attestation-date: Passed the House of Representatives September 9, 2024.
